hook: The lights go out at a sales office. The network runs on battery. The clock starts.
stat: Power is still the leading cause of impactful outages.
intro: Here is how Mova iO keeps a site running through a power cut.
s1: Ops Ramp sees the U P S at the Vadodara office switch to battery. Input voltage drops to zero, and the switch and the edge router report the same.
s2: On the U P S itself, the numbers are clear. Forty six percent load, thirty eight minutes of runtime. Mova iO checks the utility's outage notice: power is not due back for two hours.
s3: The triage agent writes the plan into the incident. Shed the load that can wait, dispatch an engineer, and tell the people in the office.
s4: Switching off cameras and meeting room access points needs a person to agree. The site lead approves in Teams, and runtime nearly doubles, to seventy one minutes.
s5: In ServiceNow Field Service, a work order goes to the nearest engineer, with the site, the U P S, and the shutdown plan attached.
s6: Everyone in the office gets a short message: what happened, how long the network will last, and what to do.
s7: When the grid comes back, the U P S goes back online, the ports come back up on their own, and the incident closes with the full timeline.
close: A power cut handled in minutes. Runtime almost doubled. Staff told before they had to ask.
tag: Site outages, handled by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
